rules.pr034_neutral_shape: shape_rerank/fuse_records: a candidate without a reference silhouette receives the mean shape RRF contribution of the known candidates instead of none
rules.pr035_digit_guard: identifier: a digit-only alias found inside a longer run of digits (a lot number, also after a word join), or any all-digit join of OCR words, is not an exact/folded hit; SQLite retrieval is unchanged, so only view selection, conflicts and id_hits move

vlm_policy: saved decisions are replayed only when the candidate pool is identical to the saved one; a changed pool is counted separately and not scored
